convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to call an unknown 'BuySell' custom indicator and depends on an external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for order management. Both require manual reimplementation in Python.

other_exits: Long position closed when DnTrend signal appears and BuyPosClose=true
Short position closed when UpTrend signal appears and SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM<0 means fixed lot size of abs(MM); MM>0 means deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: The BuySell custom indicator outputs two buffers: buffer 0 (DnTrend) and buffer 1 (UpTrend). Non-zero values indicate trend direction. Entry requires the current bar's trend buffer to be non-zero AND the opposite trend buffer on the previous bar to be non-zero (trend reversal). The SignalBar parameter (default 1) shifts which bar is used for signal evaluation. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, and LoadHistory functions — all need manual reimplementation. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean toggles allowing selective enable/disable of trade directions.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Must reverse-engineer or obtain the BuySell indicator source to reimplement its logic (MA + ATR-based trend detection with two buffers). 2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (position open/close with SL/TP, new bar detection, history loading) must be reimplemented. 3) The MM parameter dual behavior (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be handled. 4) Signal logic is straightforward: trend reversal on adjacent bars. 5) Entry/exit permission booleans must be respected.
